rv.q: If it is unfaithful, it is very winning in Talawa and Belgrade Theatre’s exuberant all-Black production, which luxuriates in its musicality and movement.

Play On! , a jazz musical conceived by Sheldon Epps with a book by Cheryl L West, is a blend of tributes... the play's moods of rapture, longing, discontent and sudden surges of energy are gorgeously present.
